C1.statement: the fluid JSON carries an EOS, and every term type of EOS[0], the one generated, is in §2.2 or §16.2

C10.statement: every rule state is in the box and outside the near-critical box, or dropped; tier A's states equal the unclamped rule; TP states pairwise distinct

C11.statement: CoolProp's own flash agrees with the generator at every TP state (1e-7; NC 1e-5)

C12.statement: water equals s05_reference.json at S05's states with T <= 646.9 K: phi partials, TP values and their T and P derivatives, Psat, dPsat/dT, both saturated phases, Tsat and dTsat/dP (values 1e-12, h and s per R T and R, lnphi absolute; derivatives 1e-11)

C13.statement: identities I1-I9 hold to 1e-30 at every TP and saturation state

C14.statement: the refusal probes cover every code of §6.5 except rows 4, 10 and 11, each with a control

C15.statement: the admitted, excluded and bound lists equal the literal ones; ids and CAS are unique

C16.statement: every published check row agrees within one unit in its last printed digit

C17.statement: the output file is at most 1.5e6 bytes

C18.statement: kappa >= 1.5 x the largest relative melting slope of the M fluids with T_t >= 20 K (measured: 6.224e-09 /Pa, Neon)

C19.statement: --emit-fluid-table reproduces the committed _coolprop_heos_fluids.py byte for byte

C2.statement: CoolProp 8.0.0 at the pinned gitrevision; each fluid_data_sha256 is stable across two reads

C20.statement: C-strip (§19.4): at T_sigma,max and T_c (1 - theta), theta in {1e-4, 5e-5, 1e-6}, k changes sign exactly twice on the union of 401 points on (0, rho_max] and 401 on [rho'', rho'], both inside (rho'', rho'), with p_sL > p_c (1 - 4e-3) and p_sV < p_c (1 + 8e-3)

C3.statement: no output key holds a coefficient array; the key set equals the schema whitelist

C4.statement: the 50-digit partials at each phi state agree with a 30-digit recomputation to 1e-25

C5.statement: the EOS critical point: |p_rho| rho_c/p_c and |p_rhorho| rho_c^2/p_c < 1e-20; T_c within 1e-3 of T_critical()

C6.statement: p_sigma(T_sigma,max) > p_c (1 - 4e-3); the critical point lies inside the box

C7.statement: at T_sigma,max both band-edge roots exist on their branches

C8.statement: dp/drho > 0 on every bracket of the 31-temperature grid; p(rho_max, T) > P_hi

C9.statement: the melting line: grid, monotonicity and T_m(P_hi) <= T_lo (§16.4)
